topic: MPLS vs. IPsec VPNs for Electric Utilities
consensus_response: MPLS VPNs offer a more robust and efficient solution for real-time QoS in electric utilities. Their dedicated paths and sophisticated congestion control mechanisms ensure low latency and jitter, crucial for time-sensitive applications like control systems.  While IPsec VPNs excel in security, their reliance on the underlying network infrastructure can hinder real-time performance when network congestion occurs.
